title: My boutiques
countFull: That’s the maximum: write to Pilotix to get more.
notOwner: Only a boutique’s owner changes its name, its link and its logo.
settingsSub: Change it here: the preview moves at the same time.
logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG · square is best · 5 MB at most
logoType: Choose a picture (PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG)
logoBig: Picture too heavy: choose a smaller one
name: Boutique name
nameHint: The name your team, your customers and the delivery people see.
free: Free: no other boutique uses it
linkHint: The start of your landing pages’ links.
oldStays: The old link {{old}} keeps working: it sends people to the new one. Your ads do not stop.
liveSub: what your team and your customers see
sample: The orders in the preview are examples.

all.title: All boutiques
all.pageOne: This page works one boutique at a time: you are seeing “{{name}}”.
all.help: Home, Dashboard, Orders, Confirmation and Follow-up show all your boutiques together. The other pages stay one boutique at a time.
all.dashNote: Details by team, agent and driver stay one boutique at a time: pick a boutique at the bottom of the menu.
all.bulkOne: Bulk actions are done one boutique at a time
all.oneAtATime: “{{what}}” is done one boutique at a time: pick the boutique.

copy.title: Copy settings
copy.sub: Take what is already set up in another of your boutiques: no need to do it all again.

parts.couriersText: The companies, their prices, their offices, Pilot Auto Assign and the wilaya parcels leave from.
parts.feesText: The price grids by wilaya, the after-sales price and overweight.
parts.statusesText: Renamed or added statuses, their order and the Suivi reasons.
parts.workText: Calls, automatic assignment, pay, the client score, Suivi’s deadlines and the columns.
parts.messagesText: The SMS / WhatsApp sent to customers, the team’s WhatsApp message and the livreur’s ones.
parts.pagesText: When a purchase counts, the reminder to a customer who did not finish, the WhatsApp button.
parts.aiText: How Message AI agent and CM AI agent talk and work. They stay on or off as they are here.

copy.keys: The same API keys (the same account at each company)
copy.note: What is ticked replaces these settings in {{name}}. The companies {{name}} already has stay. Never copied: orders, products, stock, customers, team, money, Facebook / WhatsApp accounts, pixels.
